remarks: No Mello-Roos, Low HOA!  Located in Irvine’s highly desirable Turtle Rock community, this beautifully updated home sits on a generous 8,060-square-foot lot with a spacious, private backyard and offers an exceptional location within the award-winning Irvine Unified School District, just a short walk to Bonita Canyon Elementary School, home to the APAAS program for academically advanced students. The expansive backyard is a true highlight, featuring mature lemon, orange, avocado, nectarine, and apple trees, plus four raised garden beds, while a mature pomegranate tree enhances the front yard.
